title: DC motor, steady-state load

implements.text: Current and speed from the part's steady-state curve at the voltage across it; stall as 1 / ohms
Stamped as a conductance, re-solved up to 6 passes until it moves less than 1 percent
A brushless motor blocks reverse polarity
An inductive motor switched without a flyback diode reports a spike

mocked.text: Under PWM the motor sees the time-averaged slice voltages, not a current ripple

unsupported.text: Gearbox, backlash and load torque beyond the part's load setting

parameterSources.note: each motor part file carries its own table; no datasheet page cited

validation.dataset: figures/engine/bench-solve.test.mjs: PWM halves the motor voltage; a stalled motor draws more than USB gives

errorMetrics.name: motor current vs matched ngspice
errorMetrics.condition: C15; the stopping rule of the conductance loop, not the algebra

operatingRange.evidence: default vmax 12 V in bench-solve.js:371; the 'over' state is reported above it

knownFailureCases: Realistic motor curves are not compared: both sides read the same table
